[[Image:Plain of Lances map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''Plain of Lances''' is a large plain located to the south of the [[Blight]] and spans the borders of [[Saldaea]] and [[Kandor]]. The two countries use the plain for military exercises.
